title: S3-backed Files + apricity sync (library <-> bucket, same layout)
description: S3 key layout exactly mirrors the library folder layout (stems, slices, clips, all metadata Virtuus writes). Add an S3 implementation of the Files trait beside FsFiles (Range works natively on S3); Amplify Storage bucket + access rules in the backend definition and in amplify_outputs.json. apricity sync push|pull --library <dir> using hash manifests, transferring only differences, both directions. Goal: analyze on a local Mac, push to the cloud hub, others play back and browse the metadata; no cloud analysis yet. Depends on ae24ae.
